title: Counterfactual Multihop QA: A Cause-Effect Approach for Reducing Disconnected Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's reliance on disconnected reasoning (using single-hop facts instead of multi-hop reasoning to cheat and obtain the answer) using the DiRe metric on the HotpotQA dataset. The methodology involves measuring if the model can arrive at the correct answer using only one of the ground truth supporting paragraphs.
